description: SOUTH TYROL: impacts of flood events (ED30) is a dataset listed in Environmental Data Platform - Discovery (EDP - Discovery), a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.eurac.edu. Impacts of flood events in South Tyrol (IT) taken from the ED30 database. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include Italy, features, ed30, st_hzd_evnt_hydro_ed30_apb_pnt_all. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eurac-edp.
